# Recreation Prompt

Recreate a portrait-first mobile browser clicker called **Coven Cozy Clicker**. Preserve the source mechanics: a start overlay, a large canvas tap target, score earned by each tap, idle income added every animation frame, an upgrade sheet where purchases spend score and multiply cost by 1.5, and three visual phases at 100 and 500 score. Do not add movement, collision, hard win/loss, or new economy semantics.

Transform the presentation into a cozy satirical witch sleepover inspired by Hocus-Pocus-style coven energy without using protected character names. The player taps a procedural moon-pink Main Character Cauldron to earn Bedtime Vibes. Upgrades include glitter spoons, frog familiar ASMR, barbiecore candle circles, lo-fi moon brooms, hat tilts, and coven group chats. Use pastel dream, cottagecore, and barbiecore colors, readable mobile HUD cards, one-thumb CTAs, and browser-native Canvas/CSS procedural motifs: stars, moon, attic shelf, herbs, candles, frog, potion bubbles, sparkles, bow, hat, and sleepy meme feedback.
blueprint_markdown:
# Blueprint

## Source Truth
The preserved source is a browser-native clicker/idle game. The player starts from an overlay, taps a large canvas focal object to add score, buys upgrades from a bottom sheet, gains idle income from auto upgrades, and crosses score thresholds that change visual/audio phase. There is no spatial movement, enemy collision, hard win state, or permanent loss state.

## Protected Mechanics
- Primary action: pointer/click/touch on the canvas earns score equal to current click power.
- Idle action: autoPower adds score continuously in the requestAnimationFrame loop.
- Upgrade action: each button costs score, applies either click or auto power, then multiplies its cost by 1.5.
- Progression: thresholds at 100 and 500 score switch between three phases.
- Feedback: insufficient funds produce fail feedback; successful taps/upgrades produce particles/toasts/media.
- Mobile UX: start button, menu toggle, upgrade buttons, and one-thumb canvas tapping remain reachable in portrait.

## Remixed Blueprint
The new game is **Coven Cozy Clicker**, a satirical pastel witchy bedtime tap game. The focal object is a Main Character Cauldron. Taps stir “Bedtime Vibes,” idle upgrades are cozy coven props/familiars, phase thresholds shift from calm pastel cottage to moon drama to midnight main-character chaos. The economy and state flow remain the same while world, HUD language, procedural art, background, and feedback are rebuilt.

## Safe Theming Surfaces
Copy, colors, procedural canvas drawing, background motifs, particles, upgrade names, HUD vocabulary, GIF feedback, audio selections, typography, and screen composition are safe to transform. Mechanics, economy semantics, threshold semantics, input paths, and mobile CTA actionability are protected.
